newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares close higher on tame inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares close higher on tame inflation data.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed higher, boosted by gains on Wall Street and new data showing inflation was well under control.
Analysts said the gains came despite official statements pointing to continued tight monetary policy.
The IPSA index of the 40 most-traded shares closed 0.54 percent higher to 99.05 points. The all-share IGPA ended 0.34 percent higher to 5440.41 points on total volume of 121 million shares traded.

The market was cheered by the release of consumer price data showing a rise of just 0.5 pct last month, slightly below most forecasts and suggesting the government's year-end target of 6.5 percent was on track.
